summary: Aura Minerals filed a Form 6-K furnishing its third-quarter 2026 results presentation as a foreign private issuer equivalent of a US earnings release/current report. Terms are operating, not transactional: Q3 production of 96k GEO (+27% QoQ), 9M 253k GEO, full-year guidance 340k–390k GEO, Q3 revenue US$386M at a US$4,202/oz gold price, adjusted EBITDA US$237M, AISC US$1,953/GEO, and recurring free cash flow US$124M. No special-situation event, board recommendation, advisor, or deal mechanics are disclosed; the presentation covers performance, dividends, and buybacks only.
